# Hazard fixtures

Fetched on 2026-10-26 from the official PF2e repository, ref `pf2e-8.5.0` (tag). Unchanged.

- [dispel-magic.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/foundryvtt/pf2e/pf2e-8.5.0/packs/pf2e/spells/spells/rank-2/dispel-magic.json): the pf2e 8.5.0 Dispel Magic spell (rank 2, `_id` `9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG`). It is the only Dispel Magic file in the 8.5.0 tree (one recursive tree call, 2026-10-26). hazard-builder.mjs links it as `@UUID[Compendium.pf2e.spells-srd.Item.9HpwDN4MYQJnW0LG]{Dispel Magic}`, and tests/hazard-builder.test.mjs reads its `_id` from this file.
